nanocap_mean_reversion.name: Nanocap Mean Reversion Accumulator
nanocap_mean_reversion.author: meridian-nanocap-v1

token_criteria.notes: Nanocap and low microcap tokens that have recently dumped hard. Prefer tokens with real narrative and organic volume - not freshly launched, not near ATH. Token must have a DLMM pool on Meteora. RSI(2) ≤ 30 on 5-minute chart required before deploy. Do NOT deploy into pumps or tokens near ATH. You are bottom-fishing: waiting for a V-shaped dump and catching the bounce as an LP.

entry.condition: RSI(2) ≤ 30 on 5_MINUTE confirmed - deploy SOL-only into bins below current price
entry.notes: Deploy SOL only (amount_y, amount_x=0). All liquidity sits below the current price. As the token dumps further into your range, SOL is passively converted to token at progressively lower prices - DCA averaging. On the bounce, token converts back to SOL plus fees earned throughout the dip. Zero-slippage entry. Deploy only after a clear dump.

range.notes: 85 bins below, 0 above. Wide downside range to catch 30-50% nanocap dumps. bins_above MUST stay 0 - SOL-only deployment.

exit.notes: Trailing TP - trigger at +8%, trail with 3% drop. Absolute TP at 25%. Stop-loss at -25%. Close on OOR hard-close at 120 minutes if bounce does not come. Early dump protection at -10% within 20 minutes.
